PRINCIPLE: Swift Debug builds use -Onone (zero optimization). Release builds use -O with whole-module optimization. For iOS keyboard extensions this means a 5-17x performance difference — one developer reported 7s Debug vs 0.4s Release for the same code.
APPLICATION: Never diagnose keyboard extension load time from a Debug build on device. What looks like a 5-second load bug may be <1 second in Release.
HOW: In Xcode, edit scheme → Run → Build Configuration → Release. Or use xcodebuild with -configuration Release.
EXTRA: The WhisnapKeyboard Release build config was also missing explicit SWIFT_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL and SWIFT_COMPILATION_MODE=wholemodule settings — it was inheriting -Onone from project level even in Release. Always verify keyboard target has explicit Release optimization settings.
